I don'tknow if I  remember sending a bug-note about this, but
generally you'd see

;Loading FORMAT 672-1 Does not pass the MUMBLE test ...

instead of 
;Loading FORMAT 672
-1 Does not pass the MUMBLE test ...

I've just fixed it now, by having CERROR explicity do +INTERNAL-TRY-AUTOLOADP
when the value of CERROR-PRINTER is a non-fboundp symbol.
